critical_code_review_comments: Selfie camera uses getUserMedia API - won't work in headless browser tests (by design)
Manual selfie buttons ('حضور + سيلفي', 'انصراف + سيلفي') only appear when GPS tracking is active
WiFi detection relies on navigator.connection API - may show 'not connected' in tests
Mock GPS detection checks: accuracy < 1m, altitude exactly 0, speed 0 with perfect accuracy
GPS attendance alongside fingerprint stores GPS time separately in gps_check_in field
Security logs stored in gps_security_logs MongoDB collection
All GPS/WiFi attendance requires manager approval before being finalized
seed_data_creation: Created GPS check-in records for dates 2026-03-05 to 2026-03-08 with selfie, mock GPS, and WiFi variations for testing
